Aimé and Stinson,

Just got a copy of the attached paper and thought it may have some interest for you guys.

On another note, I am putting together a workshop in the spring on the Future of Healthcare and Medical Training and will be seeking out some Lumière Santé network people to join in the discussion (2-hours on Friday February 27th). I'll let you know more as we work through the details. The idea is to "brainstorm" about the new world you guys work in every day and its implications for what we should be doing. Hope this is interesting to you and that you'll want to spend the day with us.

Take care and enjoy the weekend.

Antoine
